Definition: of Hebrew origin (H583); Enos (i.e. Enosh), a patriarch:--Enos.
BiblicalUsage: Enos stands in Luke's genealogy as the son of Seth in Luke 3:38, the grandson of Adam. He carries the line from the first man down through the generations that followed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name in a genealogy is never just a name — Enos links Adam to the world that followed, and every generation in between is part of the story God is telling. His story lives on his People profile.
